subject: QBR + Roadmap demo: cross-region slot poll and recording consent
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR + Roadmap demo — timing options and recording?

Hi Marta,

Hope you had a good weekend. We are getting the QBR + roadmap demo prepped for Helix Health and want to lock a time that works for your execs and analytics team. Our goals for the session: (1) recap last quarter’s usage trends, (2) demo the new routing and batching controls that lower token cost, and (3) agree on a rollout plan for the next phase.

Quick ask: could you confirm a preferred 90-minute slot the week of Oct 6? We usually propose two exec-friendly windows:

- Tue Oct 7, 10:00–11:30 PT / 13:00–14:30 ET
- Thu Oct 9, 08:00–09:30 PT / 11:00–12:30 ET

If neither works, I created a quick poll (link below) — pick the slots that work and we’ll surface the team. Also: are you OK with us recording the demo for your internal stakeholders? We’ll keep the recording private to Helix and Redwood.

Poll: https://calendar.redwood.com/poll/HLX-QBR-2025
Agenda (draft attached): QBR_agenda_v2.pdf

Thanks — cc’ing Mina (customer success) to help with run-of-show.

—Jonas
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
[attachment: QBR_agenda_v2.pdf]

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-19T10:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap demo — timing options and recording?

Jonas,

Thanks — appreciated. We’re aiming to have our Head of Data (Carlos), Product Lead (Priya), and two engineering managers join. A couple constraints: Carlos is out Oct 7 afternoon (ET) but available earlier that day; Priya prefers mornings ET.

Of the two windows you proposed, Thu Oct 9 at 11:00–12:30 ET would be tight for Priya. Can you add Mon Oct 6 11:00–12:30 ET as an option? If the recording includes the product notes and the plan, we’re fine with it so long as it’s marked internal-only.

I’ll also share a few calendar conflicts after I confirm with Carlos.

—Marta
Director, Analytics
Helix Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-20T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap demo — timing options and recording?

Thanks for the details, Marta — adding Mon Oct 6 11:00–12:30 ET to the poll.

I updated the agenda (attached) to include a short privacy note and a recording toggle in the run-of-show. Recording will be labeled “Helix Internal — Redwood Demo” and access restricted to people on the invite.

Next steps:
- Please mark preferred slots in the poll: https://calendar.redwood.com/poll/HLX-QBR-2025
- If you confirm attendees, we’ll lock the invite and circulate a run-of-show 48h prior.

Vanessa — can you own the backup facilitator in case Mina gets pulled into a support escalation? Mina will lead the demo content.

[attachment: QBR_agenda_v2.pdf]

Best,
Jonas

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-21T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap demo — timing options and recording?

On Mon, Sep 20, 2025 at 08:04 Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com> wrote:
> Vanessa — can you own the backup facilitator in case Mina gets pulled into a support escalation? Mina will lead the demo content.

I’m on it. I’ll review the agenda and prepare a 10-min backup walkthrough of the routing controls. Also adding a short slide about our Dedicated vs Private deployment SLAs since Helix has been asking.

I’ve uploaded a draft run-of-show to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQBR-Helix-Docs

If Mina needs to flip the order (e.g., shorten the roadmap to accommodate exec Q&A), I’ll step in and handle the live demo.

—Vanessa

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Morales <carlos.morales@helixhealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2025-09-22T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap demo — timing options and recording?

Jonas — we completed the poll and all key stakeholders can do Mon Oct 6, 11:00–12:30 ET. Thank you for accommodating the window.

We consent to the recording labeled as internal-only. Please include a 5-minute intro for the security/compliance callouts — Carlos will open with a short list of Helix’s data handling expectations.

I’ll accept the invite once Mina and Vanessa finalize the run-of-show.

See you then — Marta
